description: This is a Java test class for the GenreStatistics component in a book tracking application. It contains unit tests for methods that determine the most read, most liked, and least liked book genres, as well as some disabled tests for edge cases involving a single genre.

classes.name: GenreStatisticsTest
classes.description: Test class for GenreStatistics, verifying methods that identify most and least read/liked genres, with some tests disabled for specific edge cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, resetting the book service and populating read books.

methods.name: resetBookService
methods.description: Deletes all books from the book service to reset state.

methods.name: findMostReadGenre
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly identifies the most read genre.

methods.name: findMostLikedGenre
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly identifies the most liked genre.

methods.name: findLeastLikedGenre
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly identifies the least liked genre.

methods.name: saveBook
methods.description: Adds a read book to the service for testing purposes.
